text: dev-b: FYI shared-contracts is in-repo (libs/), inlined at build; CD change-detection ignores libs/, so core-shell and reports each need an own-dir change to redeploy. I'll do that once your contract PR (billingUrl -> /billing/v2) is merged to main. Please message me when merged. Billing needs same treatment for you.

PLAT-104-1 merged+CD green (contract on main has billing/v2). libs/ are inlined at build time, so no registry release; apps only pick it up when their own dir changes (CD builds per changed app dir) - bump your app's package.json version to trigger a rebuild.
